text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock just because it is showing a gain can feel satisfying, but I should consider its prospects and my overall plan rather than focus only on locking in profit.","A few months of account gains or losses do not establish a reliable pattern; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Since I trade rarely, I should review my holdings and goals periodically and make deliberate decisions instead of letting loss aversion or the urge to realize gains drive them."]}
